title: Google Maps Pin & Location Accuracy Update for Jeep Transit
releaseNotes: Re-verified and corrected GPS pins for all 175 selectable Jeep Transit places—including police stations, hospitals, malls, parks, transit hubs, and 55 campuses—directly against Google Maps.
Fixed major pin offsets (up to 11.8 km), corrected official DCPO PS13 Mandug & PS18 Bajada numbering, and updated relocated offices (TEU Ecoland, Maritime Police Sta. Ana, Central 911 Toril).
Removed non-existent and duplicate listings across malls, parks, and hospitals for cleaner route search.
